structureFacts: Automotive electronics growth (ADAS sensors, camera systems, lane-assist, keyless entry, engine-control computers) is expanding demand for adhesives providing electrical insulation, low ionic contamination, thermal stability, RoHS/REACH compliance

Bonding is increasingly substituting mechanical fastening/welding in automotive and electronics manufacturing for weight reduction and multi-material joining (qualitative trend, no single quantified India-specific stat found)
High technical barriers and lengthy OEM qualification cycles for critical automotive/aerospace applications function as a competitive moat in themselves

adoptionStructure.note: Once qualified into a customer's bill-of-materials, an adhesive becomes a locked-in, repeat-purchase line item until requalification is triggered — not a seasonal or SRR-style structure
